scope.description: Async runtime client completion within one valid fixed configuration, genuine non-Byzantine protocol/runtime messages, and successful storage. Focus on a delayed assignment across leader change when an old unchosen entry is replaced.
assumptions: Unique operation identity and distinct proposed values allow independent correlation.
No compaction obscures the compared entry.
Application transports actual messages to their intended recipients; delay and partition preserve per-directed-link FIFO among delivered messages.
excluded: No eventual-success or timing guarantee is imposed. Timeout, Superseded or a still-pending call is not itself a violation.
No claim of conflicting core decisions or persistent-storage failure.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target changes. Custom AsyncRuntime delegates directly to tokio spawn and sleep because selected crate default features need not expose TokioRuntime.
Caller transport replaces network I/O with FIFO queues, holding all old leader outbound messages then releasing only link 1->2 in original order.

Read observations are public API copies of the actual local decided log. Assigned positions are prefix lengths: returned k is compared at zero-based read index k-1, as established by append_tracked accepted_after.

plan_uncertainties: Only one fixed delayed-assignment history, no exhaustive interleavings or durability claims.
Bounded pending is not a liveness violation and does not count as a completed comparison.
New crate preparation may expose compilation prerequisites; semantic attribution requires current checker correspondence after execution.
grounding_unresolved: The selected runtime crate requires its own trusted compilation preparation; build failures are not protocol results.
